display.name: Confluence
display.summary: Searches, reads, and updates Confluence pages, spaces, and comments for the signed-in account.
examples: Find the onboarding page and summarise it.
Add a page for the launch plan under the Product space.
What changed in the security page?

agent.name: confluence
agent.description: Searches and updates the Confluence spaces the signed-in account can see: pages, blogs, comments, and attachments. A question naming a page without saying which system holds it may be here or in another document store.
agent.owns:
You own Confluence on the Atlassian site this sign-in can see: spaces, pages, blogs, comments, and attachments. You can search, read, create, and update. You cannot archive a page.

Call getAccessibleAtlassianResources first, then searchConfluence, then getConfluenceContent. When you report a page, give its URL.

You do not own Jira. You do not own Notion, Coda, or the other document stores.

tool_descriptions.atlassianUserInfo: Read the signed-in Atlassian account. Call this to confirm who is connected.
tool_descriptions.getAccessibleAtlassianResources: List the Atlassian sites this account can use, with their cloudId. Call this before any Confluence tool.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceContent: Read any Confluence content: page, blog, live doc, comment, whiteboard, embed, database, or folder.
tool_descriptions.listConfluenceContent: List content of one type within a single space.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceSpace: Retrieve a space by ID or key, with its enabled types and instructions.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceSpaceInstructions: Get the instructions for a space.
tool_descriptions.getConfluencePersonalSpace: Get the current user's personal space.
tool_descriptions.listConfluenceComments: List the comments on a page or blog post.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceComment: Get a single comment by ID.
tool_descriptions.diffConfluenceContentVersions: Get a unified diff between two versions.
tool_descriptions.listConfluenceAttachments: List attachment metadata for a content item.
tool_descriptions.downloadConfluenceAttachment: Get an attachment download URL, plus a curl command.
tool_descriptions.exportConfluenceContent: Export content as PDF or Word and return a download link.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceContentPermissions: Get explicit content-level permission grants as operation and principal pairs.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceContentRestrictionState: Get the general access level: OPEN, EDIT_RESTRICTED, or fully restricted.
tool_descriptions.getConfluencePublicLinkStatus: Get the external public-link (anonymous share) status.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceReactions: Get the emoji reactions on content.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceTask: Get a single inline task by ID.
tool_descriptions.listConfluenceTasks: List inline tasks, optionally scoped and filtered by status.
tool_descriptions.resolveConfluenceContentMacros: Resolve macro wrappers into per-macro HTML.
tool_descriptions.getConfluenceMauiApp: Retrieve the source and metadata for a Maui app owned by a Confluence page.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceContent: Create a page, blog post, live doc, whiteboard, database, embed, smart link, or folder.
tool_descriptions.updateConfluenceContent: Update docs, whiteboards, or databases via replacement or granular edits.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceSpace: Create a space. The response includes its ID, key, and homepage ID.
tool_descriptions.setConfluenceSpaceInstructions: Set the instructions for a space.
tool_descriptions.copyConfluenceContent: Copy a page, whiteboard, database, folder, or embed to a new parent.
tool_descriptions.moveConfluenceContent: Move a page, whiteboard, database, folder, or embed to a new parent or position.
tool_descriptions.restoreConfluenceContentVersion: Restore an earlier version as the new latest version.
tool_descriptions.convertConfluenceContentMode: Convert a page or live doc between classic and live-doc mode.
tool_descriptions.setConfluenceContentStatus: Set the content state (status) of a page or blog post.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceComment: Create or reply to a footer or inline comment.
tool_descriptions.updateConfluenceComment: Update an existing footer or inline comment.
tool_descriptions.updateConfluenceCommentResolution: Resolve or reopen a footer or inline comment.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceAttachment: Prepare an attachment upload and return a curl command.
tool_descriptions.addConfluenceReaction: Add an emoji reaction to content.
tool_descriptions.addConfluenceContentPermissions: Add content-level grants, preserving existing grants.
tool_descriptions.removeConfluenceContentPermissions: Remove content-level grants, optionally narrowed by operation or principal.
tool_descriptions.replaceConfluenceContentPermissions: Replace all content-level grants with the supplied set.
tool_descriptions.enableConfluencePublicLink: Enable the external public link for a page.
tool_descriptions.completeConfluenceTask: Mark an action item as done.
tool_descriptions.reopenConfluenceTask: Mark a completed action item as not done.
tool_descriptions.watchConfluenceContent: Subscribe to updates on a page.
tool_descriptions.unwatchConfluenceContent: Unsubscribe from updates on a page.
tool_descriptions.watchConfluenceSpace: Subscribe to updates in a space.
tool_descriptions.unwatchConfluenceSpace: Unsubscribe from updates in a space.
tool_descriptions.watchConfluenceLabel: Subscribe to updates on content with a label.
tool_descriptions.unwatchConfluenceLabel: Unsubscribe from updates on content with a label.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceInfographicForPage: Generate an infographic image for a Confluence page. Note: A typical request uses 15–30 Rovo credits.
tool_descriptions.editConfluenceInfographicForPage: Regenerate an existing infographic image on a Confluence page. Note: A typical request uses 15–30 Rovo credits.
tool_descriptions.createConfluenceMauiApp: Generate an interactive visualization for a Confluence page. Note: A typical request uses 15–30 Rovo credits.
tool_descriptions.editConfluenceMauiApp: Regenerate an existing interactive visualization on a Confluence page. Note: A typical request uses 15–30 Rovo credits.
tool_descriptions.searchConfluence: Search Confluence content with CQL. Then getConfluenceContent for the page this returns.
